FAQ

Good questions, straight answers.

Something else on your mind? Bring it to your demo.

● produkто / ask
Which AI assistant do you measure?

Produkto tracks answers from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity. The dashboard lets you explore each engine separately.

How do I improve my visibility?

Start with the fix list: facts buyers ask about that your product page doesn’t state. Adding verified facts gives assistants something to match. Whether a specific change moves your score is something we measure on the same questions, not something we promise.

Do you need access to my Shopify store?

No. We read your public product feed and pages. There’s no login, no app to install, and nothing on your store is changed.

Is the dashboard on this page live?

The website includes illustrative dashboard examples and captured AI responses. In your demo, Kelian will walk you through saved results from real scans in Produkto.
